## 原始提示词

```text
2D pixel art character sprite sheet, 4x4 grid of 16 frames forming one seamless looping animation cycle, frame 16 flows back into frame 1. Chibi proportions (about 3 heads tall), clean readable pixels, no anti-aliasing, flat cel shading with 2–3 tones per color, thick dark outline, solid pure white background, no checkerboard, no gradient, no shadows on the ground. Animation: a "spellbook mishap" loop. Frames 1–4: reading aloud — she stands with an open book, points at a line, reads with a proud expression, raises one finger like a lecturer, the book pages start to glow faintly gold. Frames 5–8: it goes wrong — a puff of smoke bursts from the book, her hair blows straight up, eyes go huge, she coughs and waves the smoke away with one hand, the book flaps in the other hand like a bird trying to escape. Frames 9–12: wrestling the book — she grabs it with both hands as it tugs left, then right, she plants her feet and leans back, tie flying, hair a mess, tiny stars circle her head, she slams it shut with a determined face. Frames 13–16: composure — she straightens her blazer, smooths her hair back down, fixes her tie, looks at the viewer with a sheepish smile and a small blush, opens the book carefully and settles into the exact frame 1 pose. Both feet stay planted on the ground in every frame, no jumps, no kicks, skirt stays still and knee-length. Character: girl with long wavy golden blonde hair with a single navy hair ribbon tied at the back, warm amber eyes, freckles, expressive face. Outfit: British-style school uniform — navy blazer with a gold crest on the pocket, white shirt, burgundy-and-gold striped necktie, grey knee-length pleated skirt, navy knee socks, black polished loafers. Holds a thick hardcover book with a dark green cover and gold trim. Same character, same proportions, same colors in all 16 frames, consistent sprite scale and identical ground line, style of a GBA / 16-bit school life sprite sheet, 64x64 pixels per frame.
```
